title: Advance for the purchase of a house and repairs to it
html:
244—P——244—Q

244-P. Advance for the purchase of a house and repairs to it—The procedure set out in paragraph 224-N will mutatis mutandis, apply. An agreement in Form no. 22-A and a mortgage bond in Form no. 22 will be used.

244-Q. The sanctioning authority should invariably furnish the Accountant General within four months from the date on which the advance, or an instalment thereof, is drawn, with a certificate that a mortgage bond has been executed in the form prescribed in these rules.
